I can’t access the web from here, so I’m unable to retrieve or verify the latest FDA guidance on cybersecurity for medical devices as of 2030-10-18; I also cannot responsibly report time‑sensitive regulatory updates from memory. For the authoritative, up‑to‑date source you should consult the FDA directly.

Check the FDA’s official pages for the current guidance: FDA’s guidance search (Regulatory Information – Search FDA Guidance Documents) https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents, the Medical Devices — Cybersecurity / Digital Health Center pages at https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices and https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/digital-health-center-excellence, and the Federal Register for published final guidance notices https://www.federalregister.gov/. On FDA’s site, search for cybersecurity guidance titles such as “Postmarket Management of Cybersecurity in Medical Devices” and “Content of Premarket Submissions for Management of Cybersecurity in Medical Devices” to confirm the current, authoritative documents.
